title: 724. Max Stack

examples.explanation: Pushes 5,1,5. Top is 5; popMax removes the upper 5; top is 1; peekMax is 5; pop removes 1; top is 5.
Push 1 then 2; popMax removes 2; top is 1.
Push 2 then 7; max is 7; pop removes 7; max becomes 2.

hints: Keep a plain list as the stack; scanning for the maximum is fine for correctness and keeps the reference simple.
popMax must delete the topmost copy of the maximum, not just any copy.
Only pop, top, peekMax and popMax append answers; push only mutates. Adaptation: operations and values run in parallel (0 marks no argument).
